ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpDPAPI Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of the SharpDPAPI tool based on CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
SharpDPAPI is a C# port of some DPAPI functionality from the Mimikatz project.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpDPAPI\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SharpDPAPI\.exe") OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ backupkey\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ blob\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ certificates\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ credentials\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ keepass\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ masterkeys\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ rdg\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ vaults\\ .*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\{.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\}\\:.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/file\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/machine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/mkfile\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/password\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/pvk\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/server\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/target\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/unprotect.*"))))
